rules.pair: Do not use Ocean and Sand together for text and background.
rules.productGradient: Do not use gradients in product controls.
rules.brandPermission: Gradients between existing colors may be used in brand artwork.
rules.proposalNotice: New supporting colors are proposals; keep existing values unchanged.

review.pair: Adopt the unordered Ocean/Sand foreground-background prohibition in all contexts.
review.brandPermission: Retain the permission as evidence; do not turn it into a hard requirement or use it to override another restriction.
review.proposalNotice: Retain the proposal/unchanged-value notice; do not infer a closed palette. All source values remain immutable.
review.modes: Bind one declared PDF source mode, one Figma captured-paint mode and one website observed state explicitly to Working; do not claim authored mode equivalence.
review.resolution: Choose PDF Ocean for this working set; retain the website value and its governing rules.
